scope: Unified diagnostic Stage1-A versus GRPO-Open S5-S9 closed-loop evaluation across safety, efficiency, cooperation, comfort, and realtime dimensions, with automatic English charts and CSV tables.

launcher.gate_failure_semantics: Evaluator return code 2 means both models and the report completed but at least one gate failed; charts are still generated and the launcher finally returns 2. Fatal or incomplete evaluation returns nonzero without charting stale output.

evaluator.geometry_and_risk: Shared-corridor oriented-box bumper gaps, threshold exposure and deficit integral, closing-pair TTC, TTC<1.5s observation, and DRAC.
evaluator.efficiency_source: Per-agent navigation travelled_length/total_length snapshots relative to the reset state plus per-step orchestrator functional-success summaries.
evaluator.cooperation_source: RuleMaker formation lock/unlock intervals, target bumper-gap error, locked speed spread, relock recovery, and censored recovery.
evaluator.comfort_source: World pose and speed at decision_dt_s for physical acceleration, jerk, yaw rate, and yaw acceleration; control-command slew is diagnostic only.
evaluator.realtime_gate: Three-vehicle complete planning-tick P95 <= 200 ms; all requested models finish before the report receives completed or completed_with_gate_failure status.
evaluator.aggregation: Episode-first. Continuous overall values are equal-weight S5-S9 scenario macro means. Binary rates retain x/n with two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals.
evaluator.comparison: Strict (scenario, route, seed) pairs with 10000 fixed-seed scenario-stratified bootstrap samples; repeats verify reproducibility and do not increase n_pairs.
evaluator.interpretation: No composite score and no overall-better verdict. Each metric reports baseline, candidate, candidate-minus-baseline, units, direction, n_pairs, and 95% interval; episode duration is descriptive.

chart_generator.nullable_semantics: Unavailable TTC, recovery, spacing, success time, and insufficient-history physical comfort observations remain N/A; observed numeric zero remains zero.

supporting_runtime_changes.role: Cache terminal-frame navigation, geometry, speed, and scenario summaries before agent removal; execute evaluator-precomputed low-level controls once.
Use current orchestrator summary state without triggering duplicate functional-evidence updates.
Make S7-S9 stable-formation evidence counters idempotent within one simulator step.
